'''House Tirado''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Tear]].

The only known member of the house is Lady [[Yseidre Tirado]], who was a noblewoman of the province of Tear during the days of [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire|Empire]]. After the High King's death in {{fy|994}}, Lady Yseidre formed an alliance with Lord [[Istaban Novares]] and seized control of the city and the surrounding countryside. With neither being powerful enough to become king or queen of the nation, they formed a ruling council, which developed into the [[High Nobility of Tear]] during the [[War of the Hundred Years]].

As House Tirado has not been mentioned in the events around {{ne|998}}, it may be extinct.
